about: The Workbench icons of the LaserKombat drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/laserkombat.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a tank firing its laser into a mirror) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/laserkombat.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. LaserKombat-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, LaserKombat.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's LaserKombat.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Controls, ReadMe-LaserKombat, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt.
